Message.Name: Login Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to log in to the replay or recovery channel.

Message.Name: Recovery Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to request data on the recovery channel.

Field.Name: Request Level
Field.Description: Defines the level of the request.

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: GTP Instrument identifier if Request Level is 0. Blank if not.

Field.Name: Group ID
Field.Description: Group/Segment ID if Request Level is 1. Blank if not.

Field.Name: Request Order Book Type
Field.Description: Only considered if the Request Level is 0. If specified, only data related to the specified order book type is provided. If not specified, data for all available book types for the instrument are provided. For Recovery Type = 3 (Statistics) this has to be set to '0' = All.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Mandatory field if Request Level = 1. Not considered for other Request Levels.

Field.Name: Recovery Type
Field.Description: The type of messages to be replayed.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Only valid if Recovery Type = 2 (Trades). If specified, the trades reported with an equal or higher sequence number will be sent.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: The value set in this will be echoed back in the corresponding Recovery Response and Recovery Complete. The system will not validate uniqueness of the set value.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to accept or reject a login request to the replay or recovery channel.

Message.Name: Recovery Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to respond to a snapshot request on the recovery channel.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number on the real-time channel with which the snapshot is synchronised when Recovery Type = 1, 2, 3, 4. This will be zero for other Recovery Types or if Status is not 'A'.

Field.Name: Count
Field.Description: Number of messages to follow, not including any Replay and Recovery Complete messages. This will be zero if Status is not 'A'.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Will include the value set as Request ID in the Recovery Request message.

Message.Name: Replay and Recovery Complete Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to indicate the successful completion of servicing a message replay or a recovery request.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Will include the value set as Request ID in the Recovery Request message.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Current Trading status of the Instrument. Populated only when the message is sent at the end of individual order book snapshots during a trading session.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate the start and end of the day.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument

Message.Name: Instrument Directory Extended Message
Message.Description: Reference data for equity instruments, published on the recovery channel in place of the real time Instrument Directory message

Field.Name: Allowed Book Types
Field.Description: Defines the order-book types that are allowed for the instrument. Each designated bit represents a book type. 0 means not allowed and 1 means allowed.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Venue Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument identifier used by the source venue.

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment or instrument group ID as identified by the trading market.

Field.Name: Tick ID
Field.Description: The tick structure applicable for the instrument.

Field.Name: Previous Day's Closing Price
Field.Description: Primary market's closing price reported for the previous trading day.

Field.Name: Reserved Field
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Any value in this field should be ignored.

Field.Name: Minimum Lot/Minimum Execution Size
Field.Description: Indicates the minimum quantity or nominal value tradable on the market for a security.

Field.Name: Last Price In Preceding Session
Field.Description: Last execution price in a session prior to the current trading day.

Field.Name: Last Price In Preceding Session Date
Field.Description: Last execution date in a session prior to the current trading day.

Field.Name: Clearing Type
Field.Description: Indicates the settlement mode of the security.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Trading System's partition in which the instrument is traded.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: MTF Common Symbol of the instrument.

Message.Name: Instrument Status Message
Message.Description: Used to communicate scheduled and unscheduled session changes

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Current trading status of the instrument.

Field.Name: New End Time
Field.Description: New time the session will end. The field will contain only spaces if Session Change Reason is "0" or the Session Change Reason is not present. New End Time will be in terms of the local time on the server (i.e., not UTC).

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book the status applies to.

Message.Name: Add Order Incremental Message
Message.Description: Sent to instruct recipients to add a new displayable order to the retrospective order book

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: Transaction execution timestamp as reported by the upstream system

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book the order rests on.

Message.Name: Top of Book Message
Message.Description: Used to update the level 1 service following any change to the consolidated Best Bid and Offer

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Bid Market Size
Field.Description: Aggregated size of all bid market orders. Value will be 0 if there are no market orders.

Field.Name: Bid Limit Price
Field.Description: Price of the best buy limit order

Field.Name: Bid Limit Size
Field.Description: Aggregated size of all orders at the best buy limit price.

Field.Name: Offer Market Size
Field.Description: Aggregated size of all offer market orders. Value will be 0 if there are no market orders.

Field.Name: Offer Limit Price
Field.Description: Price of the best sell limit order

Field.Name: Offer Limit Size
Field.Description: Aggregated size of all orders at the best sell limit price.

Message.Name: Order Book Clear Message
Message.Description: Sent to instruct recipients to remove all orders from the order book for the specified instrument

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate trades executed on supported markets

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: Execution timestamp as reported by the supported market.

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Hidden Execution Indicator
Field.Description: For Turquoise Lit Order Book, 1[2] will be sent for execution of visible[hidden] quantities. For Turquoise Plato Order Book, it will always be set to 2 (Hidden).

Message.Name: Trade Cross Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate a cross trade execution

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: Execution timestamp as reported by the supported market.

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Cross ID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the BTF Order.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The type of the BTF Order:

Message.Name: Statistics Snapshot Message
Message.Description: A snapshot of an instrument's statistics that is used for recovery

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative volume of all trades for the trading day.

Field.Name: Volume (on-book only)
Field.Description: Cumulative volume for the trading day excluding off-book trades.

Field.Name: VWAP
Field.Description: Volume weighted average price for the day for all trades.

Field.Name: VWAP (on-book only)
Field.Description: Volume weighted average price for the day excluding off-book trades.

Field.Name: Number of trades
Field.Description: Count of all trades for the day.

Field.Name: Number of trades (on-book only)
Field.Description: Count of trades for the day excluding off-book trades.

Field.Name: Turnover
Field.Description: Turnover of all trades for the day.

Field.Name: Turnover (on-book only)
Field.Description: Turnover for the day excluding off-book trades.

Field.Name: Trade High (on-book only)
Field.Description: Current trading day high price excluding off-book trades.

Field.Name: Trade Low (on-book only)
Field.Description: Current trading day low price excluding off-book trades.

Field.Name: Trade High
Field.Description: Current trading day high price of all trades.

Field.Name: Trade Low
Field.Description: Current trading day low price of all trades.

Field.Name: IAU Price
Field.Description: Contains the last reported Indicative Auction Crossing Price.

Field.Name: IAU Paired Size
Field.Description: Quantity to be matched at the last reported indicative price.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of auction the statistics relate to.

Field.Name: Last Trade Price
Field.Description: Executed price at which the instrument was last traded. If no relevant trades have taken place the value '0' will be populated.

Field.Name: Last Trade Quantity
Field.Description: Executed quantity of the trade which set the Last Trade Price. If no relevant trades have taken place the value '0' will be populated.

Field.Name: Last Trade Time
Field.Description: Transaction time of the trade which set the Last Trade Price. If no relevant trades have taken place the value '0' will be populated.

Message.Name: Mifid II Trade Message
Message.Description: Sent to represent different types of MiFID compliant trades published by markets

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Please refer to the Additional Field Values section for valid values.

Field.Name: Transaction identification code
Field.Description: A unique trade identifier. The value will be right aligned.

Field.Name: MiFID Price
Field.Description: MiFID compliant Price field populated using executed price.

Field.Name: MiFID Quantity
Field.Description: Number of units of the financial instrument. {DECIMAL-18/17}

Field.Name: Trading Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was executed/agreed upon.

Field.Name: Price Major Currency
Field.Description: Major currency in which the price is expressed (applicable if the price is expressed as monetary value).

Field.Name: Notional Amount
Field.Description: Notional value relevant to the security.

Field.Name: Notional Currency
Field.Description: Major currency in which the notional amount is denominated.

Field.Name: Venue of Execution
Field.Description: Identification of the venue where the transaction was executed.

Field.Name: Publication Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was published.

Field.Name: Trading System
Field.Description: Type of trading system where the transaction was executed.

Message.Name: Mifid II Trade Cross Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate a MiFID compliant cross trade

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Please refer to the Additional Field Values section for valid values.

Field.Name: Cross ID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the BTF Order.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The type of the BTF Order.

Field.Name: MiFID Price
Field.Description: MiFID compliant Price field populated using executed price.

Field.Name: MiFID Quantity
Field.Description: Number of units of the financial instrument. {DECIMAL-18/17}

Field.Name: Trading Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was executed/ agreed upon.

Field.Name: Price Major Currency
Field.Description: Major currency in which the price is expressed (applicable if the price is expressed as monetary value).

Field.Name: Notional Amount
Field.Description: Notional value relevant to the security. {DECIMAL-18/5}

Field.Name: Notional Currency
Field.Description: Major currency in which the notional amount is denominated.

Field.Name: Venue of Execution
Field.Description: Identification of the venue where the transaction was executed.

Field.Name: Publication Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was published.

Field.Name: Trading System
Field.Description: Type of trading system where the transaction was executed.

Message.Name: Mifid II Order Book Update Message
Message.Description: Aggregated order book price level update published on the MiFID II Pre Trade service

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Level Identifier
Field.Description: For continuous trading, position of the price point in the order book. For periodic auction, this will be set to the default value.

Field.Name: Update Date and Time
Field.Description: For continuous trading, the date and time when the aggregated bid or offer price or volume was calculated following the receipt of an order for execution, cancellation, or modification into the trading system. For periodic auction, the date and time at which the price would best satisfy the trading algorithm.

Field.Name: Instrument Identification Code
Field.Description: Code used to identify the financial instrument (ISIN code)

Field.Name: Order Book Side
Field.Description: For continuous trading, the side corresponding to the price level in the order book. For periodic auction trading system, this will be set to the default value.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: For continuous trading, a price of orders aggregated at a given price level. For periodic auctions, the price at which the auction trading system would best satisfy its trading algorithm. Will be set to 0 (zero) when the order book is cleared or the indicative auction price is reset.

Field.Name: Price Currency
Field.Description: Major currency unit in which the price is expressed

Field.Name: Price Notation
Field.Description: Indicates the notation in which the price is expressed

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: For continuous trading, number of units of the financial instruments aggregated on the price level. For periodic auction, the aggregated quantity attached to the price that would best satisfy the trading algorithm. Will be set to 0 (zero) when the order book is cleared or the indicative auction price is reset.

Field.Name: Aggregated no of orders and quotes
Field.Description: For continuous trading, the number of orders aggregated at a given price level. For periodic auction and empty side during continuous trading, this will be set to 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Venue
Field.Description: Identification of the trading venue through the system of which orders are advertised. In accordance with ISO 10383 segment MIC or, where the segment MIC does not exist, the operating MIC

Field.Name: Trading System
Field.Description: Type of trading system where the order is advertised

Field.Name: Trading system phase
Field.Description: Type of trading system phase where the order is advertised

Field.Name: Publication Date and Time
Field.Description: Date and time when the information was published by the trading venue.

Field.Name: Order Book Update
Field.Description: The position of the price level within the order book. This field should be ignored if the message is disseminated through the recovery service.

Bitfield.Name: Order Book Update
Bitfield.Description: Position of the price level within the order book

Field.Name: Last Price Level
Field.Description: Set if the current price level is the last level in the top five price points
